about:
MERGE swarm: fuse hygiene / semantics / space / affordance into one registry of set pieces.

Reads   shots/kits/cut/catalog.json (read-only), shots/scion2/setpieces/{hygiene,semantics,space,affordance}.json
Writes  shots/scion2/setpieces/registry.json   one record per set piece (all 2,227 parts incl. refs)
        shots/scion2/setpieces/conflicts.json  every cross-swarm disagreement and how it was resolved

Field ownership (who decides what; every record's `provenance` repeats this with the evidence):
  name, category, scene ......... semantics (category may be corrected by a MERGE misfile rule, recorded)
  grade, defects, duplicate_of .. hygiene
  usable ........................ AND of hygiene.usable, not semantics.skip, not character-fragment, space.placeable;
                                  any one swarm saying "do not place" wins (conservative)
  plane, contact, view, tile, size_cm, scale_src .. space (plane may be corrected by a MERGE rule, recorded)
  affordances ................... affordance (dropped when unusable; confidence capped when category disagrees)
Every MERGE rule is listed in RULES below with its id; records cite the ids that fired.

rules.U1: hygiene grade C / usable=false -> unusable (hygiene owns pixel cleanliness)
rules.U2: semantics skip=true (character fragment, sheet lettering, reference/assembled/example label) -> unusable even when hygiene passed it
rules.U3: semantics category character-fragment -> unusable (a body part is not a set piece)
rules.U4: space placeable=false (reference/assembly wording on the label) -> unusable
rules.U5: unusable parts get grade C (grade_hygiene keeps the hygiene grade) and lose their affordances (kept under affordances_dropped)
rules.U6: semantics flag "registry grade C" is NOT used: hygiene re-measured the registry reasons and owns the call
rules.U7: MERGE: label contains "reference only" / "assembled" / "assembly" / "example" / "states assembled" / "poses reference" -> unusable (viewed: assembly views)
rules.U8: MERGE: text-graphic with an EMPTY label AND (semantics pixel test thin strokes/text strip OR hygiene CLIP text > object) -> unusable (unnamed lettering). v1 fired on any text-graphic without a label class and killed the TIDE OFFICE plate, a blank number strip, a marquee poster frame and a thread (viewed) -> now needs an empty label.
rules.U9: MERGE: printed heading on a torn tan paper strip (measured merge/tanstrip.json: tan>=0.7, dark 0.04-0.4 in the middle 60% of rows, aspect>=5) -> unusable label_strip. Viewed: 7 "(N CARDS)" / "REFERENCE ONLY" strips on 10.fx.ride-light that hygiene and semantics passed.
rules.U10: MERGE: measured lettering signature (merge/letters.json): achromatic>=0.85, dark>=0.30 (was 0.35; missed WHEEL SPOKE INSERT at 0.32-0.33), white outline pale>=0.15, aspect>=2 (black capitals with a white rim), OR a label box: achromatic>=0.95, pale>=0.4, dark 0.01-0.3, aspect>=2 -> unusable label_strip. Viewed: "LIGHTS", "PARTS", "FRONT WHEEL RING", "8 wide light pool" box. Black objects (platters, screens) fail on achromatic/aspect.
rules.P3: MERGE: usable text-graphic not on an .fx. sheet and without overlay/reflect/chalk/flood/line words -> plane near_set, flag contact_doubt (name plaques, EXIT sign, TIDE OFFICE plate are physical signs, not overlays; viewed).
rules.U11: MERGE: hygiene baked_caption AND hygiene CLIP text beats object by >=0.015 AND >=15 alpha components -> unusable (an "ASSEMBLED REFERENCE" scene image with its heading baked in; viewed 2 hits; the projection frame at +0.012 stays usable).
rules.C4b: MERGE: C4 is skipped when semantics CLIP zero-shot is >=0.9 sure of the furniture class: the tableware label belongs to a neighbouring card (viewed: "7 ESPRESSO CUP (TABLE)" and "8 SAUCER" are bentwood chairs). Category kept, grip dropped, label_doubt.
rules.C5: MERGE: every part on 02.props.poet-eye-aperture is the poet's eye (iris, sclera, lids, light point) -> character-fragment, unusable (viewed: "LOWER LID", iris rings were filed as ground/light-fx).
rules.U4o: MERGE overturn: space placeable=false or U7 came only from reference/assembled wording in the label/id, but hygiene passed the pixels and CLIP sees an object more than text or a reference sheet (text<=object, refsheet<=object, no refsheet_look/reference_label defect) -> usable, flag label_doubt. Viewed: lantern, gold rim, terraces, hanging foliage, pearl bracelet, door frame, VU backing were all clean pieces carrying a mis-attached heading.
rules.U2o: MERGE overturn: semantics skip came only from a heading-like label or "sheet lettering" pixel test, but hygiene passed it with no label_strip, CLIP text < object and the pixel test is not "text strip" -> usable, flag label_doubt. Viewed: a thread (T5), the marquee front.
rules.H1: MERGE overturn: hygiene's ONLY blocking defect is clipped_edge (corner clip) and category is aperture/architecture/light-fx -> usable grade B, flag hygiene_overturned. Viewed: shadowpool tunnel frames, temple "4. COMPLETE", temple shadow wedge are intact (hygiene itself listed them as doubtful). The cage front (other) keeps C: it has a baked caption and border line.
rules.C2: MERGE: character-fragment whose label names furniture/an object (sofa/couch/chair arm, marionette control, glass/acetate panel) or is only the caption "Poet" -> category from that noun or semantics' next fused class; U2/U3/U4 lifted. Viewed: sofa arm, marionette crossbar, handprint glass panel, a quay ground strip labelled "Poet".
rules.C3: MERGE: affordance grip (confidence>=0.62 from a label word) on architecture/backdrop/aperture/ground/furniture -> handheld-prop. Viewed: folded paper, poem paper, staff shaft.
rules.C4: MERGE: label noun cup/saucer/coupe/mug/espresso on furniture/vehicle/ground -> handheld-prop (coupe is a champagne glass, not a car; viewed). label "facade" on handheld-prop -> architecture.
rules.C1: MERGE: semantics light-fx, but space found an opaque object on an fx sheet with an object-noun label (pills, heart, clock ...) -> category taken from the noun
rules.P1: MERGE: category light-fx and space plane near_set with a code-only/empty label (C07, G01, BO1, w04) -> plane overlay_fx (viewed: comet swirls, glints, smudge words, flames). Exception after viewing: hygiene CLIP object_best is a plant -> category plant-nature, plane near_set (orbit-harvest tulips/stems); a building/wall -> architecture, plane mid_set (BO1-3 lit tower strips).
rules.P2: MERGE: category backdrop on far_backdrop is fine; handheld-prop / furniture / wearable on far_backdrop or overlay_fx -> plane near_set, flagged
rules.F1: space scale_conflict (own size vs sheet scale > 40%) -> flag size_doubt
rules.F2: size_cm outside the plausible range for the category -> flag size_doubt
rules.F3: affordance kind incompatible with category -> confidence capped at 0.35, flagged
rules.F4: semantics conflict (label class != CLIP class) and hygiene label_mismatch -> flag label_doubt
rules.F5: category light-fx but plane not overlay_fx (after P1) -> flag plane_doubt
rules.F6: duplicate_of set -> not best copy; query() hides it unless include_dups=True
